rubric_items.reason: No missed weakness found. No new route. countByDoctor uses bind parameters, the link uses URLSearchParams, the count renders as React text, no patient fields are added, and a PATCH test shows the read-only field cannot be set.
SF-2 and most checked-fine cites point to the exact line. The 404 cite points to a comment line (L71) instead of the throw at L65, and SF-1 cites the return line instead of the route permission line.
Both findings are rightly minor. In the MVP every permission is granted, so SF-1 is a design note. SF-2 is a bounded, indexed per-doctor count. No blocker or major triggers apply.
The fix directions are clear but deferred: decide on a permission when sign-in lands, and keep the count per doctor. Neither names a concrete check or owner.
Both findings hold up against the source, and none is a false positive.
